meta.name: ingest
meta.description: When you paste raw human input — a call transcript (Grain, Zoom, Granola, Fathom), a text or email from a client/partner/friend, a voice-memo dump, or meeting notes — and want it converted into structured work. Extracts decisions, action items (yours vs theirs), bugs/feature requests, and facts worth keeping; files GitHub issues in the right repo, captures to the second-brain vault, and drafts (never sends) the reply. Triggers on "/ingest", "ingest this", "here's my call with X," "here's the transcript," "this is from [person]," "[person] asked me this," "from [person]:", a pasted transcript with speaker labels, or a forwarded client message that clearly expects processing. Person→project routing lives in a private config; unknown senders get asked about once, then remembered.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通话录音、聊天记录变成待办事项和备忘，并代拟回复。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常处理会议纪要和客户消息，担心遗漏行动项。
copy.tagline_en: Turn call transcripts and messages into to-dos and notes, and draft replies.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle meeting notes and client messages and worry about missed action items.

howto.what: 装上后,把通话记录、邮件或语音备忘等原始内容贴给Claude并说“处理一下”,它就会完整读一遍,提取其中的决定、双方行动项、缺陷或新需求;回信只草拟不发送,内部记录存入笔记,该跟进的问题按对应项目建档。
howto.when: 当你说出“/ingest”“ingest this”等指令,或直接贴来带说话人的通话记录等需要处理的原始内容时。

say.text: 这段和客户的通话记录,帮我处理一下
say.note: 会提取双方行动项并草拟跟进回复。

say.text: 邮件里有新需求,处理一下并草拟回信但别发
say.note: 会创建对应任务单并给出草稿。

say.text: 整理这段会议的语音备忘,提取待办就行
say.note: 语音备忘只做记录,不生成回复草稿。

howto.what_en: After install, pasting a transcript/email/voice memo and saying “process this” makes Claude read it all, extract decisions, actions, bugs/requests, draft a reply (never sent), store notes, and file issues in the right project.
howto.when_en: Triggered by “/ingest”, “ingest this”, or pasting raw content (e.g., a speaker-labeled call transcript) that expects processing.

say_en.text: Process this call transcript with the client.
say_en.note: It extracts decisions/actions and drafts a reply.

say_en.text: Ingest this email; draft a reply but don’t send it.
say_en.note: It files an issue and drafts a response.

say_en.text: Turn this voice memo from the meeting into action items.
say_en.note: Voice-note: capture only, no reply draft.
